Lightning Talk: Execution Policies: Not a Forward Progress Guarantee - Ruslan Arutyunyan - CppCon 2025
---

Execution Policies seem to create a lot of confusion in C++ community. Some people think that they are hard prescription what algorithms should do, others think this is a hint. 

This talk aims to give a short and actually useful summary about Execution Policies:
- What they are and what they are for
- What it means to pass an execution policy to a parallel algorithm
